signal: Only complete4h UTC. Box=last8closed4h BEFORE breakout. Width<2.2*ATR14simple BEFORE breakout; that ATR is below mean of30ATR14values ending on last box candle. Breakout closes above boxhigh, volume>=1.3*mean20previous, positive body>=0.5*ATRbeforebreakout. No extra EMA/RSI/macro/absoluteATR floor. false->true4h. Entry=boxhigh*1.0015 roundedDOWN. Stop=min(boxmidpoint-oneTick,entry-1.2*ATR14includingbreakout), roundedDOWN: use the lower technical level, not the tighter one. Stop invalid rejected. Proposed gross target>=2% amplitude gate retained, no claim that target construction creates edge.
entry: Modeled post_only at next4h open. Reject marketable proxy. Valid4hours [placedAt,placedAt+4h), no chase or taker conversion. Need ALL4entry-hour minute windows even if no fill. Only one pending/filled position, reserve retained through all4hours. Partial fills idempotent; cancel remainder on stop, target, protection or expiry. Subminimum protectable inventory blocks.
target: Compute maker limit to deliver>=3.0RNET from actual fills/sellable inventory including maker buy/sell, dust and conservative separate reserve. Initial R is projected NET loss at original stop with taker fee/friction. Round targetUP. Stops/protected/trailing exits use TAKER; never claim maker0.2% roundtrip unless actual modeled makerTP fills.
makerBuffer: Maker target fills EXACTLY at its resting limit (never below sell limit). Extra uncertainty reserve equal to entry-notional*effectiveFriction is debited separately pro-rata at maker exits, not represented as an OKX fee or worse maker price. Effective friction=(1+slippage)*(1+spread/2)-1. Stop fill uses this friction in taker price, with no duplicate maker reserve.
protection: At CLOSED1m net liquidation PnL>=1.2*initialR, cancel entry remainder and raise stop to project total trade PnL>=+0.2RNET. New stop valid NEXT minute, never retroactive. At CLOSED1m net liquidation>=2R arm trailing, still below3RNET maker target. Gaps can defeat floor.
targetPosting: After each entry fill, target is recomputed for actual inventory and posted only after that minute closes if above modeled bid; otherwise it is not counted as maker, and fixed-price posting can be retried at later closes. A new entry-fill minute cannot also receive target profit. No TP market fallback.
intrabar: Confirmed1m for all4entry hours, and later hours where stop/target/next netR threshold might be reached; closed4h trailing uses only fully known source bars. Missing event evidence pauses replay/fetches exact public hour. Stop first; no target on newfill minute; resting maker target needs strict trade-through and participation; no same-hour portfolio reuse. No forced time-stop or end liquidation.
portfolioGuards: Existing3%daily,10%drawdown new-entry halts and1h cooldown after3losses; no claim of native kill-switch validation.
